reports.title: Statistics Act (統計法)
reports.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS), Executive Yuan
reports.description: Fundamental law governing the production, quality, objectivity and independence of government statistics in Taiwan. Defines the scope of official statistics, the role of BAS agencies, and the framework for basic national censuses and surveys.
reports._notes: Foundational recurring-citation node, parallel to Japan’s Statistics Act and Korea’s Statistics Act. Explicitly aims to ‘ensure the objectivity and independence of government statistics’ and ‘uphold the quality of government statistics’.
_referenced_by: All subsequent DGBAS statistical methodologies and quality frameworks
Official descriptions of the R.O.C. government statistical system

reports.title: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) / National Statistics system
reports.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan
reports.description: Central authority for official statistics in Taiwan. Oversees the national statistical system, produces major economic and social statistics, maintains statistical standards and classifications, and coordinates BAS units across government.
reports._notes: Institutional core node. Equivalent to Japan’s Statistics Bureau / MIC and Korea’s KOSTAT. Disseminates via National Statistics portal and related platforms.
reports._cadence_evidence: eng.stat.gov.tw is the DGBAS dissemination portal itself, not a titled periodical: the homepage carries a rolling stream of press releases (GDP, earnings, price indices, labour force all dated August 2026) plus query systems and an advance release calendar; no single cadence applies to the site.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Population and Housing Census / Population statistics
reports.description: Periodic Population and Housing Census together with inter-censal population estimates and vital statistics. Provides the demographic baseline for labour, social and economic statistics.
reports._notes: Core demographic series. Parallel to Japan and Korea census nodes.
reports._cadence_evidence: Executive Yuan announcement of the 109年人口及住宅普查方案 states '政府每10年定期舉辦人口及住宅普查'; the 109年普查初步統計結果 PDF on stat.gov.tw gives census standard date 109/11/8 and the decennial series 89年(2000)/99年(2010)/109年(2020).

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index and related price statistics. Primary measure of inflation used in monetary policy, wage and social analysis.
reports._notes: Standard core price node. Continuously cited in Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) policy and economic analysis.

reports.title: Manpower Survey / Labour Force statistics
reports.description: Monthly survey of labour force, employment, unemployment and labour-force participation. Principal source of official labour-market indicators.
reports._notes: Core labour series. Parallel to Japan’s Labour Force Survey and Korea’s Economically Active Population Survey.

reports.title: National Accounts (System of National Accounts)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts compiled according to SNA 2008 standards. Covers GDP by expenditure and by industry, national income, savings and related aggregates. Includes regular revisions and quinquennial benchmark revisions.
reports._notes: Macroeconomic core. Parallel to Japan’s JSNA and Korea’s national accounts.
reports._cadence_evidence: DGBAS SDDS metadata for National accounts (eng.stat.gov.tw/sdds/cp.aspx?n=4180&s=1798) states Periodicity: 'Quarterly'; Timeliness: 'Advance estimates: Approximately one month after the end of the reference quarter. Preliminary estimates: Approximately seven to eight weeks after the end of the reference quarter.'

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual Balance of Payments statistics covering current account, capital and financial account, and reserve assets. Taiwan typically records large current-account surpluses.
reports._notes: Core external-sector series from the central bank. Continuously cited in external-vulnerability and exchange-rate analysis.

reports.title: Industrial Production Index
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / DGBAS-related sources
reports.description: Monthly Industrial Production Index with detailed manufacturing breakdowns. Semiconductor and electronics-related components are especially closely watched given their weight in Taiwan’s industrial structure and exports.
reports._notes: High-frequency activity indicator. Semiconductor and electronic-parts production is a defining feature of Taiwan’s industrial cycle and global supply-chain role.

reports.title: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) — institutional role and statistical publications
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange reserves, and a wide range of monetary, financial and external statistics (BOP, money supply, interest rates, banking statistics, etc.).
reports._notes: Institutional counterpart to BOJ and BOK. Produces the principal monetary and external statistics that complement DGBAS national accounts and price data.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBC publications page (cbc.gov.tw/tw/cp-969-33796-5E814-1.html) lists its flagship statistical vehicle 金融統計月報 as '月刊' (monthly); the same list shows 中央銀行季刊 and 國際收支平衡表季報 as '季刊' and 年報/金融穩定報告 as '年刊'.

reports.title: Producer Price Index / Wholesale Price Index
reports.description: Monthly producer / wholesale price indices measuring industrial and wholesale price movements. Complements the CPI in the price-statistics suite.
reports._notes: Standard complementary price series to CPI.

reports.title: Trade Statistics (Customs-based merchandise trade)
reports.description: Monthly customs-based statistics on merchandise exports and imports by commodity and partner. Critical for tracking Taiwan’s export-oriented performance, especially in electronics and semiconductors.
reports._notes: Core trade series that feeds BOP goods account and industrial-policy analysis. Semiconductor and ICT export shares are defining structural features.

reports.title: National Statistics portal / statistical dissemination system
reports.description: Central web dissemination platform for official statistics produced by DGBAS and coordinated agencies. Functional equivalent of e-Stat (Japan) and KOSIS (Korea).
reports._notes: Infrastructure node that underpins discoverability and citation of the entire official statistical output.
reports._cadence_evidence: The National Statistics portal is a dissemination platform (query systems, SDDS metadata pages, advance release calendar, rolling press releases) rather than a dated publication; no release cadence is stated for the portal itself.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Cross-Strait Economic Statistics Monthly / MAC compilation
reports.description: Regular official compilation of cross-strait trade, investment and people-exchange indicators. Draws on Customs, Investment Commission, immigration and tourism sources to present a coherent Taiwan-side picture of the economic relationship. Primary statistical product for cross-strait analysis.
reports._notes: Institutional core of the cross-strait statistical cluster. Already flagged in earlier batches; this node formalises it as the central recurring series.
_referenced_by: Customs trade statistics (China / Hong Kong partner share)
Outbound investment analysis and BOP financial account
reports._cadence_evidence: MAC 兩岸經濟統計月報 listing shows consecutively numbered monthly issues — newest No.399 (115年07月) back to No.390 (114年10月) on page 1 — with 共279筆 issues in the archive, i.e. one issue per month.

reports.title: ECFA Early Harvest List execution statistics (goods and services)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / International Trade Administration / ECFA-related offices
reports.description: Official statistics on the implementation of the ECFA Early Harvest programmes for goods (tariff reductions, certificates of origin issued, estimated tariff savings) and the limited services openings. Early-harvest share of Taiwan’s exports to China has declined markedly over the past decade.
reports._notes: Quantifies the preferential layer of the relationship. The declining relative importance of the early-harvest list is itself a structural signal of decoupling.
_referenced_by: ECFA legal text and subsequent policy evaluations
Customs trade data and tariff-revenue analysis
reports._cadence_evidence: ecfa.org.tw could not be read (robots/TLS blocked) and the MAC/ITA pages carrying ECFA 早期收穫計畫執行情形 give no stated update cadence; no dated series of execution reports could be counted.

reports.title: Taiwan outbound investment to Mainland China — flow and stock statistics
reports.publisher: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Approved cases and amounts of Taiwanese investment in Mainland China. Cumulative stock since 1991 exceeds US$210 billion and historically dominated Taiwan’s outbound investment; annual flows have fallen to low single-digit shares of total outbound investment in recent years (3.8 % in 2025, lower still in early 2026).
reports._notes: Highest-visibility investment node. The collapse in relative share is one of the clearest quantitative markers of structural decoupling.
_referenced_by: BOP financial account and international investment position
reports._cadence_evidence: MOEA Investment Review Division publishes 核准僑外投資、陸資來臺投資、國外投資、對中國大陸投資統計速報/統計月報; the site's own release notices are per-month (e.g. '115年6月核准…投資統計情形'), i.e. one release per month.

reports.title: Geographic distribution of Taiwanese investment in Mainland China
reports.description: Breakdown of approved investment by Mainland province / municipality. Jiangsu, Shanghai, Guangdong and Fujian have consistently absorbed the large majority of the stock and of residual flows.
reports._notes: Spatial detail that links the investment stock to specific Mainland industrial regions.
_referenced_by: Outbound investment to Mainland China statistics
reports._url_evidence: MOEA Department of Investment Review page for 對中國大陸投資分區分業月資料統計 — approved investment in Mainland China broken down by region and industry.
reports._cadence_evidence: The page (moea.gov.tw ContentDesc menu_id=43021) is '對中國大陸投資分區分業月資料統計' — explicitly 月資料 (monthly data), published by 經濟部投資審議司 with coverage 2016-06-17 to 2026-06-17.

reports.title: Mainland Chinese investment in Taiwan — approved cases and amounts
reports.publisher: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Statistics on approved inbound investment from Mainland China. Volumes remain tightly restricted and numerically small relative to Taiwan’s overall FDI inflows and to the historical outbound stock.
reports._notes: Asymmetric counterpart to the large outbound stock. Highlights the controlled and limited nature of capital inflows from the Mainland.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same MOEA Investment Review series (陸資來臺投資 is one of the four categories in the 統計速報/月報), released once per month — the site's news items are titled by month (e.g. 115年6月核准…統計情形).

reports.title: Cross-strait trade share of Taiwan’s total trade (exports and imports)
reports.description: Time-series indicators of the share of Taiwan’s total exports and total trade accounted for by Mainland China (and China + Hong Kong). Documents the decline from peak dependence (exports to China+HK ~44 % in 2020) to substantially lower shares by 2025.
reports._notes: Key dependence / decoupling indicator. Provides the quantitative backbone for arguments about structural change in the commercial relationship.
_referenced_by: Headline trade statistics and BOP goods account
reports._cadence_evidence: Cross-strait trade shares are carried in MAC's 兩岸經濟統計月報, whose listing shows consecutive monthly issues (No.390–No.399, 共279筆).

reports.title: Cross-strait people-exchange and visitor statistics
reports.publisher: Mainland Affairs Council / National Immigration Agency / Tourism Administration / Ministry of Education
reports.description: Statistics on outbound travel by Taiwan residents to Mainland China, inbound visitors from the Mainland, and student / youth exchange numbers. Series are highly sensitive to political and public-health conditions and have been the subject of recent official concern regarding asymmetric youth exchanges.
reports._notes: People-to-people layer of the relationship. Complements the purely commercial trade and investment nodes.
reports._cadence_evidence: MAC 經貿交流統計 page lists 兩岸經濟統計月報 and 金馬小三通航運人員往來統計月報 — both 月報 (monthly reports) — as the vehicles for people-exchange figures.

reports.title: Cross-strait financial and banking linkages (where statistically tracked)
reports.publisher: Financial Supervisory Commission / Central Bank / MAC-related sources
reports.description: Available official statistics and regulatory reporting on Taiwanese banks’ presence in Mainland China, residual financial linkages, and related prudential indicators. Limited relative to the historical trade and investment stock.
reports._notes: Financial-channel counterpart to the trade and direct-investment nodes. Relatively constrained by regulation.
_referenced_by: Outbound investment and corporate exposure analysis
reports._url_evidence: FSC Banking Bureau 兩岸金融 section; publishes 兩岸銀行業互設分支機構現況統計表 and cross-strait banking supervision material.
reports._cadence_evidence: Banking Bureau 兩岸金融 page carries a single dated table (兩岸銀行業互設分支機構情形統計表, stamped 1150414) plus regulations and news; the page states no publication interval and is informational rather than a statistical series.

reports.title: AI / HPC demand concentration on Taiwan manufacturing
reports.publisher: MOEA industrial statistics / science-park revenue / export-order series
reports.description: Statistical and official commentary showing that the surge in AI-server, high-performance computing and advanced-packaging demand is disproportionately served by Taiwanese manufacturing capacity. This concentration intensifies both the commercial value and the strategic weight of the Taiwan pole inside the triangle.
reports._notes: Demand-side amplifier of the silicon-shield logic. Explains recent extreme growth rates and the heightened geopolitical salience of the manufacturing pole.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOEA Department of Statistics home page shows the fixed monthly release calendar '當月最新調查統計發布: 25日 工業生產, 20日 外銷訂單', with dated monthly releases (2026-07-23 工業生產, 2026-07-21 外銷訂單) — the production/order data behind AI-demand concentration are monthly.

reports.title: Whole-of-Society Defense Resilience Committee / All-Out Defense Mobilization statistics
reports.description: Institutional and statistical products of the Whole-of-Society Defense Resilience Committee (established 2024) and the All-Out Defense Mobilization Agency. Tracks civil-defense personnel registration (recently >3.2 million), training slots, strategic material and food reserves (rice stockpiles exceeding national-security standards), and multi-sector resilience planning (energy, medical, information, critical supply).
reports._cadence_original: periodic committee reports + audit and mobilisation statistics
reports._notes: Key bridging node between the pure military cluster and the broader demographic, energy and social clusters. Makes ‘resilience’ statistically visible rather than purely rhetorical.
_referenced_by: National Defense Report and asymmetric special budgets
reports._cadence_evidence: MND's All-out Defense Mobilization Agency (adma.mnd.gov.tw) publishes 動員紀實 once a year: 114年動員紀實 (115.02.25), 113年動員紀實 (114.02.24), 112年動員紀實 (113.02.07).

reports.title: Civil defense personnel registration and training statistics
reports.publisher: All-Out Defense Mobilization Agency / National Audit Office reporting
reports.description: Quantitative series on the number of registered civil-defense personnel, training completions, multi-category registrations, and related mobilisation readiness indicators.
reports._notes: Manpower-side densification of the resilience cluster. Links directly to the demographic constraints already mapped.
reports._url_evidence: National Police Agency official statistical report 一級報表(本署)-民防團隊編組 (civil defence team organisation), with report format and compilation notes.
reports._cadence_evidence: NPA dataset page for 民防團隊編組 gives only 一級報表(本署) and 最後更新 114-10-20; no 更新頻率 or dated series of editions is shown.

reports.title: LNG imports, natural-gas supply and energy-security statistics
reports.publisher: Energy Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Statistics on LNG import volumes, supplier composition (Qatar, Australia, United States, others), gas consumption (power generation dominant), and related energy-security indicators. AI-driven electricity demand from semiconductors and data centres is explicitly linked to rising gas requirements in recent official commentary.
reports._notes: High-value cross-cluster node. Links energy security to (1) the semiconductor/AI electricity load, (2) the ART’s large US LNG purchase pledges, and (3) resilience planning. Strengthens the energy arm of the triangle.
_referenced_by: Energy Statistics Handbook and electricity generation mix
US–Taiwan ART purchase commitments (LNG and energy equipment)
Industrial production and AI-demand concentration nodes
reports._cadence_evidence: Energy Administration publishes 能源統計月報 (Energy Statistics Monthly Report) at ea01.moeaea.gov.tw/a0303/02/en/newest/monthly/ and moeaboe.gov.tw web_book book=M_CH, built on monthly supply tables (e.g. 4-1能源供給(月)) — one issue per month.

reports.title: US–Taiwan ART / related commitments on energy and critical-equipment purchases
reports.publisher: AIT–TECRO / USTR / Taiwan official fact sheets
reports.description: Specific quantitative commitments embedded in the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade and associated understandings for long-term purchases of US LNG, crude oil, civil aircraft, power equipment and related items. Provides a concrete commercial edge from the economic-security architecture into Taiwan’s energy-import statistics.
reports._cadence_original: null (commitment-based, tracked in subsequent trade data)
reports._notes: Direct quantitative bridge between Batch 8 (ART) and the energy-security cluster.
reports._cadence_evidence: The US–Taiwan Agreement on Reciprocal Trade is a signed bilateral agreement — USTR press release 'Ambassador Greer Oversees Signing of U.S.-Taiwan Agreement on Reciprocal Trade' and the accompanying Fact Sheet, February 2026. A single signed instrument with purchase commitments, not a periodical.

reports.title: Fiscal and tax revenue links to semiconductor / electronics sector
reports.description: Available statistical indicators of the contribution of the electronics / semiconductor sector to corporate tax, business tax and overall fiscal revenue, and of the fiscal cost of Industrial Innovation Act / Chip Act incentives. Links the high-profit semiconductor cluster to public-finance capacity (including rising defence budgets).
reports._notes: Fiscal densification. Makes the public-finance consequences of the semiconductor boom (and its tax incentives) visible and connectable to the defence-spending trajectory.
_referenced_by: National accounts and government finance statistics
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Finance 財政及賦稅統計 section (fiscal and tax statistics, analyses, statistics databases); no semiconductor-specific series exists, this is the governing official series.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOF 財政統計月報 page (mof.gov.tw/singlehtml/285) states monthly issuance by 財政部統計處 and lists complete 12-issue years (114年 Jan–Dec, 113年 Jan–Dec, 115年 Jan–Jun so far), back to 100年.

reports.title: Cybersecurity, information resilience and C4ISR statistics / programmes
reports.description: Programme and statistical traces of cybersecurity, critical-information-infrastructure protection, and military C4ISR resilience efforts. Appears in special-budget lines, Whole-of-Society Resilience workstreams, and digital-affairs reporting.
reports._notes: Digital-security bridge between the pure defence cluster and the digital-economy / ICT nodes.
reports._url_evidence: Administration for Cyber Security (MODA) 資通安全網路月報 report series page, with monthly editions through July 2026.
reports._cadence_evidence: moda.gov.tw/ACS/press/report/670.html is the 資通安全網路月報; the listing shows one dated edition per month (2026-08-17 for 115年7月, 2026-07-15 for 6月, 2026-06-25 for 5月 …) with 共74筆資料.

reports.title: Strategic material and food-reserve statistics
reports.description: Statistics on public grain (rice) reserves, strategic material stockpiles, and related readiness indicators that form part of the whole-of-society resilience framework. Recent rice reserves have exceeded the formal national-security standard.
reports._notes: Material-side densification of the resilience cluster. Links agriculture and food-security nodes to the defence-mobilisation architecture.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read. Ministry of Agriculture page 'Taiwan liangshi gongxu zhuangkuang yu quebao Taiwan liangshi anquan zhi zhengce cuoshi'. It states the statutory standard - under the 'Guonei daomi anquan cunliang biaozhun' a safety reserve of not less than three months of domestic rice consumption must be held - and confirms that in recent years the minimum annual public-grain (gongliang) stock has stayed above that legally mandated three-month level, which is exactly the claim in the node description. Also gives annual rice availability of about 1.32 million tonnes brown rice and the 144,720-tonne annual import quota (~90% self-sufficiency). NOTE ON SCOPE: this covers the grain/food reserve only. I found no official published series for non-food strategic material stockpiles or All-Out Defense Mobilization Agency readiness indicators. Supporting sources also verified: the MOA statistics book index https://agrstat.moa.gov.tw/sdweb/public/book/Book.aspx lists the 'Liangshi gongxu nianbao' (Food Supply and Utilization Yearbook, latest ROC 113 edition) but exposes it only via a JavaScript __doPostBack, so it has no citable URL; the food balance sheet dataset is at https://data.gov.tw/dataset/96330.
reports._cadence_evidence: The MOA page is an article in 農政與農情, identified as 97年10月（第196期）with that year's block running 187–198期 = 12 issues per year (monthly series carrying grain-supply/food-security reporting).

reports.title: Labour-shortage and skill-mismatch projections (NDC / Ministry of Labor)
reports.publisher: National Development Council / Ministry of Labor
reports.description: Official projections of labour shortages (hundreds of thousands of workers by 2030) and survey data on unfilled vacancies, especially in manufacturing, R&D and technical roles linked to the semiconductor and high-tech sectors. Coexists with elevated youth unemployment — a structural contradiction repeatedly noted in policy analysis.
reports._notes: Quantitative backbone of the talent constraint and social dualism story.
reports._url_evidence: NDC 產業人力供需資訊網: hosts 重點產業人才供需調查及推估, 2030 manpower demand projections and vacancy surveys.
reports._cadence_evidence: NDC manpower site (theme.ndc.gov.tw/manpower) lists 2030 整體人力需求推估, 重點產業人才供需調查(3年期) and 人力供需調查 items dated May 2023, June 2023, August 2023, August 2024 with '第二次/第三次' rounds — no stated periodicity and no regular interval to count.

reports.title: Family / child policy responses linked to fiscal capacity from high-tech growth
reports.publisher: Executive Yuan / Ministry of Health and Welfare / National Development Council
reports.description: Policy instruments (including proposed or expanding child/growth allowances) that are explicitly or implicitly framed as using fiscal space generated by high-tech growth to address ultra-low fertility and family costs. Links the semiconductor fiscal node to the demographic and social-policy clusters.
reports._notes: Social-policy edge that closes the loop from industrial boom → fiscal capacity → demographic response.
_referenced_by: Fiscal / tax revenue links to semiconductor sector
reports._url_evidence: MOHW 少子女化對策 special section detailing 育兒津貼 and 托育補助 amounts and the 少子女化對策計畫 2.0 (2026–2029).
reports._cadence_evidence: MOHW page cp-5130-58003-1.html is a standing policy hub for 0-6歲國家一起養 (建檔日期 107-08-01, 更新時間 115-07-13). It is edited as policy changes, with no release cadence and no dated editions.

reports.title: County and city household disposable-income rankings
reports.description: Annual rankings of average household disposable income by county and city. Hsinchu City (and often Hsinchu County) and Taipei regularly occupy the top positions, illustrating the spatial income consequences of the high-tech cluster.
reports._notes: Key quantitative bridge from the industrial geography to the social dualism story.
_referenced_by: Hsinchu City/County and Taipei City nodes

reports.title: Science-park geographic system (Hsinchu, Central, Southern and related sites)
reports.publisher: National Science and Technology Council / Science Park Bureaus
reports.description: The formal science-park system as a spatial-industrial hierarchy: Hsinchu as the historic and still-central core, Central Taiwan Science Park, Southern Taiwan Science Park (fastest recent growth), and associated sites. Anchors the high-tech geography of the island.
reports._notes: Geographic backbone of the semiconductor spatial structure.
_referenced_by: Individual park revenue and employment statistics
reports._url_evidence: NSTC 科學園區 section page including 園區分布及介紹 (park distribution and introduction) covering Hsinchu, Central and Southern parks.
reports._cadence_evidence: NSTC folksonomy list page is a navigation index (園區分布及介紹, 園區動態, 園區統計資料庫, 園區生態整合資訊) with no dated items and no stated frequency.

reports.title: Indigenous peoples population statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of the Interior / Council of Indigenous Peoples
reports.description: Official statistics on the registered Indigenous population (recently ~629,000 / 2.7 % of total), by recognised tribe (Amis, Paiwan, Atayal and others), age structure (younger median age than the national average) and dependency ratios.
reports._notes: Distinct demographic component with different age structure from the super-aged national average. Adds social and identity depth to the demographic cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Council of Indigenous Peoples series page 原住民人口數統計資料(每月一次) — monthly registered indigenous population statistics releases.
reports._cadence_evidence: Council of Indigenous Peoples data list is titled '原住民人口數統計資料(每月一次)' — explicitly monthly; entries run one per month (newest 115年7月, published 2026-08-14) across 31 pages of archive.

reports.title: Indigenous population by county / city (Hualien, Taoyuan, Taitung concentrations)
reports.region: Multiple (especially eastern counties and selected metros)
reports.description: Geographic distribution of the Indigenous population. Highest absolute numbers in Hualien County, Taoyuan City and Taitung County — linking eastern peripheral counties and certain urban areas to the Indigenous demographic node.
reports._notes: Spatial edge that connects the Indigenous demographic series to the sub-national geography already mapped.
_referenced_by: Taoyuan and other municipal demographic profiles
reports._url_evidence: CIP current 統計資料 monthly population series; a checked release contains 台閩縣市 and 鄉鎮市區 tables by tribe and sex, i.e. the county/city distribution.

reports.title: Plains Indigenous (Pingpu) status recognition and registration framework
reports.publisher: Council of Indigenous Peoples / Ministry of the Interior
reports.description: Legal and administrative framework (including the recent Plains Indigenous Peoples Status Act) for recognition and registration of Plains Indigenous groups. Ongoing applications and status determination create a living policy and statistical process.
reports._notes: Legal-status node that expands the Indigenous cluster beyond the 16 officially recognised tribes.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read. Council of Indigenous Peoples page 'Pingpu yuanzhuminzuqun shenfen fa ji qi zifa' (the Plains Indigenous Peoples Status Act and its subordinate regulations), uploaded 12 January 2026, last updated 15 May 2026. It carries the presidential promulgation order for the Act plus three implementing regulations with explanatory notes: the recognition review board's organisation and operation rules, the identity-verification requirements and community-consultation implementation rules, and the ethnic-classification (minzubie) determination procedures - i.e. the recognition and registration framework the node describes. Note the Act's exact title is 'Pingpu yuanzhuminzuqun shenfen fa'. The presidential promulgation text is separately downloadable at https://www.president.gov.tw/File/Doc/c2ae92d3-cbc3-4f67-9fe5-1c978bda3223 (Hua-Tsung-I-I No. 11400110031, 23 October 2025). law.moj.gov.tw remains robots-disallowed and was not used.
reports._url_route: responsible agency's own site (cip.gov.tw) instead of the robots-disallowed law.moj.gov.tw
reports._cadence_evidence: The page hosts the 平埔族群身分法 and its subordinate regulations — a Presidential Order plus two 辦法 (審議會組織規程, 身分認定辦法), published 2026-01-12. A statute and implementing rules, not a recurring publication.

reports.title: Foreign residents by region / nationality statistics
reports.publisher: National Immigration Agency / Ministry of the Interior
reports.description: Official counts of foreign residents broken down by nationality and by county / city. Complements the earlier foreign-worker node with a full resident-stock and geographic distribution view.
reports._notes: Geographic densification of the migration cluster. Links foreign presence to the same spatial hierarchy as the Indigenous and general population series.
reports._cadence_evidence: NIA statistics pages (immigration.gov.tw/5385/7344/7350 and /70395) show only four dated feature items (2026-06-25, 2026-08-05) and no stated update frequency for the 外僑居留 tables.

reports.title: Water resources and water-use statistics (domestic, industrial, agricultural)
reports.publisher: Water Resources Agency, Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Annual and regional statistics on water use by sector (domestic, industrial, agricultural), supply sources (surface, ground, reservoirs, alternative), and regional balances. Industrial water demand is a recognised constraint for semiconductor expansion.
reports._cadence_original: 1 (Water Use Statistics Yearbook) + higher-frequency operational data

reports.title: Industrial water demand and semiconductor-related water constraint indicators

reports.title: Industrial and science-park land-use / land-availability statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / National Science and Technology Council / local governments

reports.title: Semiconductor / IC industry production and structure statistics
reports.description: Official and industry-linked statistics on IC design, wafer foundry, IDM and packaging/testing output, global market shares, and contribution to industrial production and exports. reports._cadence_original: periodic / annual + high-frequency industrial production detail
reports._notes: Highest-uniqueness industrial node for Taiwan. Foundry market share ~60 %+ and advanced packaging leadership create a structural dependency that pulls industrial production, trade, BOP goods, and investment statistics into a tight cluster. Essential for force-layout cluster formation around technology/manufacturing.

reports.title: Vital Statistics — births, total fertility rate, crude birth rate
reports.description: Annual and monthly vital statistics on live births, crude birth rate and total fertility rate. Taiwan has recorded one of the world’s lowest fertility rates (recent crude birth rate ~4.6 per 1,000; TFR well below replacement and recently the lowest globally in some readings).
reports._notes: Demographic uniqueness parallel to (and in some metrics more extreme than) Korea. Creates strong edges into population, ageing, labour supply and social-policy nodes.

reports.title: Super-aged society indicators (65+ share ≥ 20 %)
reports.description: Official tracking of the share of population aged 65 and over. Taiwan crossed the 20 % threshold and is formally a super-aged society under UN criteria. Accompanied by rising old-age dependency and declining youth share.
reports._notes: High-authority demographic status node. Links tightly to fertility, population projections and social-protection series — the same cluster pattern that strengthens Japan and Korea force structures.

Ageing-society white papers and policy evaluations

reports._notes: Supporting services and external node; sensitive to cross-strait and regional travel conditions.
_referenced_by: Services trade in the Balance of Payments
reports._cadence_evidence: Tourism Administration publishes 觀光統計月報 (admin.taiwan.net.tw/businessinfo/FilePage?a=14642), whose tables were last updated 115-08-10; the 觀光統計資料庫 offers both 月表 (monthly) and 年表 (annual) reporting, with the monthly report as the regular release.

reports.title: Health and medical statistics (beyond long-term care)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Health and Welfare / National Health Insurance Administration
reports.description: Statistics on health status, medical utilisation, National Health Insurance expenditure and related system indicators.
reports._notes: Complements the long-term care node and strengthens the health–ageing cluster.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOHW Department of Statistics publishes 醫事機構服務量統計年報 once a year: 114年 (2025-07-31), 113年 (2024-07-29), 112年 (2023-07-30) — annual editions released each July.

reports.title: Wage and salary statistics / Earnings survey
reports.description: Statistics on earnings by industry, occupation, firm size and other characteristics. Source for wage-gap and labour-cost analysis.
reports._notes: Links labour, cost and household-income clusters.
_referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost series
reports._cadence_evidence: DGBAS SDDS metadata, Labor market: Wages/Earnings — Periodicity: 'Monthly'; Timeliness: '40 days after the end of reference month' (受僱員工薪資調查).

reports.title: Cross-Strait Economic Relations Statistics (Mainland Affairs Council)
reports.description: Regular official compilation of cross-strait trade, investment, and people-to-people exchange statistics. Draws on Customs, Investment Commission and immigration/tourism sources to present a coherent picture of economic interaction across the Taiwan Strait.
reports._notes: Unique institutional product. Parallel in spirit to Korea’s official North Korea statistical indicators. Creates strong, explicit edges between the ECFA node, China-partner trade, investment flows and people-exchange series.
reports._cadence_evidence: MAC 經貿交流統計 lists 兩岸經濟統計月報 and 兩岸經濟交流統計速報; the 月報 archive runs consecutively numbered monthly issues (No.399 = 115年07月, 共279筆).

reports.title: Agriculture, forestry and fishery statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture / Fisheries Agency / DGBAS
reports.description: Statistics on agricultural production value, farm households, fishery production and related rural indicators. Completes the primary-sector coverage alongside manufacturing and services.
reports._notes: Sectoral completion node. Also feeds the regional-contrast edges (eastern and agricultural counties are ageing faster and less dense).
_referenced_by: Regional contrast (agricultural counties vs special municipalities)
reports._cadence_evidence: 農業部統計處 統計書刊 lists 農業統計年報 as a 年報 with one edition per year, each published in early July: 114年(115/07/01), 113年(114/07/03), 112年(113/07/03) … back to 105年(106/07/03).

reports.title: Banking sector statistics (loans, deposits, soundness)
reports.publisher: Financial Supervisory Commission / Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
reports.description: Statistics on the banking system — outstanding loans and deposits, asset quality, capital adequacy and related soundness indicators. Complements the CBC monetary aggregates and Financial Stability Report.
reports._notes: Deepens the financial cluster. Strong edges into monetary, stability and real-estate/credit nodes.
_referenced_by: CBC Financial Conditions and monetary aggregates
reports._cadence_evidence: Banking Bureau 金融統計 page shows monthly series released each month — 金融統計指標 (115年6月, released 2026-08-17), 金融業務統計輯要 (115年6月, 2026-08-17) — alongside quarterly 基本金融資料 (115年第2季).

reports.title: Insurance sector statistics (life and non-life)
reports.description: Regular indicators of the insurance industry — premiums, assets, claims, solvency and related metrics for life and non-life insurers. Taiwan’s life-insurance sector is large relative to GDP.
reports._notes: Completes the major financial-institution triad (banks, insurers, securities). Relevant to household balance-sheets and ageing-society financing.
_referenced_by: Financial Stability Report and FSC overview statistics
reports._cadence_evidence: Insurance Bureau publishes 保險市場重要指標 monthly: 115年4月 (released 2026-06-30), 115年3月 (2026-05-31), 115年2月 (2026-04-30), 115年1月 (2026-03-31) — one edition per reference month across 8 pages of archive.

reports.title: Outbound and inbound investment statistics (Investment Commission)
reports.publisher: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Official statistics on approved outbound investment (including the large historical stock directed to Mainland China) and inbound FDI. Key source for cross-strait and global investment patterns.
reports._notes: Tightens the investment and cross-strait clusters. Historical Mainland China share of outbound investment remains large even as diversification proceeds.
reports._cadence_evidence: 經濟部投資審議司 issues 核准僑外投資、陸資來臺投資、國外投資、對中國大陸投資統計月報/速報 once per month, with releases titled by reference month (e.g. 115年6月核准…統計情形).

reports.title: Securities and capital-market statistics
reports.description: Statistics on equity-market capitalisation, trading activity, listed-company performance and related capital-market indicators. Semiconductor and electronics firms dominate market capitalisation and trading.
reports._notes: Links the high-tech industrial cluster to capital-market outcomes and household wealth.
reports._cadence_evidence: SFB 證券暨期貨市場重要指標 is published one edition per reference month (e.g. 101年12月份, 101年11月份, 101年10月份 …), each posted about 15–19 days after month end.

reports.title: Crime and justice statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on reported crime, clearance rates, prosecution and judicial caseloads.
reports._notes: Supporting social-structure node.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Justice Crime Prevention Research Center series page for 我國犯罪狀況及其分析, listing 46 annual editions through 2024.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOJ 犯罪防治研究中心 publication list shows one crime-analysis report per year — 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019 and continuing back over decades, one edition per calendar year.

reports.title: Broader environmental statistics (air, water, waste, protected areas)
reports.description: Statistics on air and water quality, waste generation and treatment, protected areas and related environmental indicators that complement the GHG inventory.
reports._notes: Expands the environmental cluster beyond GHG.
_referenced_by: National GHG Inventory and Climate Change Response Act
reports._cadence_evidence: MOENV's environmental-statistics section points to the 環境統計查詢網(ESDQ) query system; neither moenv.gov.tw nor the statistics site states a publication frequency or lists dated yearbook editions.

reports.title: Internal migration and household registration statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of the Interior / Department of Household Registration
reports.description: Statistics on internal migration flows, household registration changes and related population-mobility indicators that underpin regional concentration patterns.
reports._notes: Feeds the spatial-concentration edges.
reports._cadence_evidence: Household-registration population statistics are released monthly: DGBAS SDDS Population metadata states Periodicity 'Monthly', Timeliness '10 days', and MOI lists 內政統計月報 as '每月'.

reports.title: External debt statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
reports.description: Statistics on external debt by sector and maturity, complementing the large FX-reserve stock and persistent current-account surplus.
reports._notes: Completes the external-vulnerability picture alongside reserves and BOP.
_referenced_by: Balance of Payments and international investment position
reports._cadence_evidence: DGBAS/CBC SDDS metadata for External debt states Periodicity 'Quarterly' and 'The preliminary quarterly external debt data are disseminated 50 days after the end of the reference quarter… the press release dates usually fall on the 20th of Feb., May, Aug. and Nov.'

reports.title: Digital / ICT industry and computer & information services statistics
reports.description: Statistics on computer programming, information services, digital-industry turnover and related ICT service activity. Complements the semiconductor hardware cluster with the software, systems-integration and digital-transformation layer.
reports._notes: Extends the technology cluster from hardware (foundry/OSAT) into software, cloud, AI-related services and digital transformation. Strengthens edges between industrial production, R&D and services trade.
_referenced_by: R&D expenditure (business-sector software and systems components)
National accounts services detail and export of ICT services
reports._cadence_evidence: moda 數位產業署 產業統計專區 publishes 電腦及資訊服務業營業額統計 每季 — 114年第1季, 第2季, 第3季, 第4季 (Q4 released 2026-02-26), i.e. four releases per year.

reports.title: Earnings structure / salary statistics (share below average, industry differentials)
reports.description: Detailed earnings statistics showing average regular earnings, the share of employees below the mean (recently >70 %), and industry differentials. Electronics and financial services sit well above the mean; education, accommodation/food and other services sit well below.
reports._notes: Deepens the dual-structure labour picture. High semiconductor/electronics earnings versus lower-service and traditional-industry earnings create clear edges into inequality and household-income nodes.
_referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost
Semiconductor and high-tech wage premium analysis
reports._cadence_evidence: DGBAS SDDS Labor market: Wages/Earnings — Periodicity: 'Monthly', Timeliness: '40 days after the end of reference month'; the monthly 薪資及生產力統計 news release carries the earnings-distribution indicators.

reports.title: Minimum wage / basic wage framework and adjustments
reports.description: Statutory minimum (basic) wage level and the periodic adjustment process. Affects a large number of workers and feeds into labour-insurance and pension contribution bases.
reports._notes: Policy anchor for the lower end of the wage distribution. Recurring citation in labour and social-policy documents.
_referenced_by: Labour insurance and pension contribution tables
reports._cadence_evidence: MOL 基本工資之制訂與調整經過 lists adjustments taking effect on 1 January of consecutive years (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 …), and notes that from 114年1月1日 基本工資 was replaced by 最低工資 under the new act — one review/adjustment per year.

reports.title: Protected areas / biodiversity conservation statistics
reports.publisher: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency / Ministry of Agriculture / Ministry of Environment
reports.description: Statistics on national parks, nature reserves, wildlife protected areas and overall protected-area coverage (land and marine). Taiwan has designated a substantial share of its territory under various protection categories.
reports._notes: Expands the environmental cluster beyond climate/GHG into biodiversity and spatial conservation. Useful for regional and land-use edges.
reports._cadence_evidence: Forestry Agency conservation site (redirected to forest.gov.tw/Ecological) lists 年報 and a 雙月刊 among publications and a 生態調查資料庫, but gives no dated protected-area statistical editions and no explicit frequency.

reports.title: Foreign / migrant worker statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Labor / National Immigration Agency
reports.description: Statistics on the stock and characteristics of foreign industrial and care workers. Material to labour-supply analysis under ultra-low fertility and rapid ageing.
reports._notes: Demographic–labour bridge node. Parallel to Korea’s foreign-residents cluster and Japan’s foreign-worker statistics. Strengthens edges between ageing, care and labour supply.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOL labour statistics query system (statdb.mol.gov.tw) labels the series '(每月)' and the ministry's 統計專刊 includes 勞動統計月報; migrant-worker headcounts are updated monthly.

reports.title: Labor Insurance and Labor Pension statistics
reports.publisher: Bureau of Labor Insurance / Ministry of Labor
reports.description: Statistics on Labor Insurance coverage, benefits, and the Labor Pension system (including contribution bases linked to the minimum wage). Central pillars of the social-insurance response to ageing.
reports._notes: Social-insurance core that links wages, ageing and fiscal sustainability.
reports._cadence_evidence: Bureau of Labor Insurance statistics section states 統計月報 released '每月' (bli.gov.tw/0013086.html) and 統計年報 '每年' (0013087.html), with a 發布時間表 at 0013165.html.

reports.title: National Health Insurance statistics
reports.description: Statistics on NHI coverage, expenditure, utilisation and financial status. Universal system that interacts closely with ageing and long-term care demand.
reports._notes: Complements the broader health and long-term care nodes; central to the social-protection cluster.
reports._cadence_evidence: NHI 健保統計專區 / 重要統計資料 pages show datasets refreshed on mixed, unstated schedules (most items stamped 115.7.22; 疾病資訊 annually 114.11.19; others 114.08.28) with no declared publication frequency.

reports.title: Science and technology policy white papers / National Science and Technology Council strategic documents
reports.description: Periodic strategic documents and white papers that set R&D, semiconductor, AI and digital-economy priorities. Recurringly cited in budget, industrial and talent-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Strategic recurring-citation node that sits above the R&D and semiconductor statistical series.
reports._cadence_evidence: NSTC 出版品 list (13 items) shows 科學技術統計要覽 among the publications but states no frequency, and neither 科學技術白皮書 nor 國家科學技術發展計畫 appears with dated editions on the page.

reports.title: Detailed price statistics (CPI components, housing-related prices)
reports.description: More granular CPI component series and housing-related price indicators that complement the headline CPI and PPI.
reports._notes: Deepens the price cluster and links it more tightly to housing and living-cost edges.

reports.title: Business demography / establishment and enterprise statistics
reports.description: Statistics on the number, entry, exit and survival of establishments and enterprises by size and industry. Complements SME and large-enterprise structural views.
reports._notes: Structural foundation for firm-size dualism edges.
_referenced_by: Industrial production and employment by firm size
reports._cadence_evidence: Enterprise/establishment counts come from the 工業及服務業普查, taken every five years — the standing census plans on the statute site are 一百十五年(2026) and the preceding 110年(2021) census, a five-year interval.

reports.title: Electronic Components Industry — Production, Sales and Inventory statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Statistics
reports.description: Detailed monthly/annual statistics on production, sales and inventory value of the electronic components industry (the core statistical category that contains semiconductors and related devices). This series is the primary high-frequency official measure of semiconductor-related manufacturing activity.
reports._notes: Highest-frequency official semiconductor-proxy series. Recent double-digit growth driven by advanced-process and AI-related demand makes this a central pulse node for the entire technology cluster.
_referenced_by: Headline Industrial Production Index (electronics components dominate recent growth)
Export orders and customs export statistics for electronics

reports.title: Computers, Electronic & Optical Products Industry production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Statistics
reports.description: Production statistics for computers, electronic products and optical products — the downstream and equipment-related layer that has been strongly boosted by AI servers, semiconductor equipment and high-performance computing demand.
reports._notes: Complements the components series. AI-server and semiconductor-equipment demand has produced extreme year-on-year growth rates, creating tight edges into the components and export-order nodes.

reports.title: Science Parks aggregate revenue, employment and firm statistics (Hsinchu, Central, Southern)
reports.publisher: National Science and Technology Council / Science Park Administrations
reports.description: Official statistics on the three major science parks: aggregate revenue (recently record levels driven by the integrated-circuit sector), number of firms, employment, and industry composition. IC sector accounts for the large majority of park revenue.
reports._notes: Geographic and organisational heart of the semiconductor cluster. Revenue now measured in trillions of NT$; IC sector dominance creates a clear high-authority sub-graph.
_referenced_by: Regional contrast and Taipei–Hsinchu axis nodes
reports._cadence_evidence: NSTC issues one aggregate science-park results release per year: '科學園區2025年營收5.8兆元，成長21.83%' (2026/03/11) and '科學園區2024年營收約4.76兆元，成長20.73%'.

reports.title: Hsinchu Science Park detailed statistics
reports.description: Detailed statistics for the original and still-core Hsinchu Science Park — firm counts, employment, sales by industry (especially IC), and investment. Remains the densest single locus of advanced semiconductor activity.
reports._notes: Core geographic node of the foundry and design ecosystem. Strengthens the Taipei–Hsinchu axis already flagged in earlier batches.
_referenced_by: Northern Taiwan regional and labour statistics
reports._url_evidence: Hsinchu Science Park Bureau 歷年統計資訊: firm counts and sales, employment by education level, R&D expenditure and patents by industry.
reports._cadence_evidence: SIPA 統計資訊/出版品 page lists 月報 (monthly statistics report) and 預算、決算書及會計月報 alongside 歷年統計資訊 — the park's statistics are issued as a monthly report.

reports.title: Southern Taiwan Science Park statistics and semiconductor expansion
reports.publisher: Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau / NSTC
reports.description: Statistics for the Southern Taiwan Science Park, which has recorded the fastest recent growth and is the principal locus of the southward expansion of the semiconductor ‘S-corridor’.
reports._notes: Captures the spatial expansion of the semiconductor cluster beyond the traditional Hsinchu core — important for regional and industrial-policy edges.
_referenced_by: Regional contrast (southward shift of high-tech activity)
reports._url_evidence: Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau 現況統計 page: revenue, import/export, employment, leasing and investment statistics.
reports._cadence_evidence: STSP statistics page lists categories (營業額, 進出口, 從業員工, 租賃, 來賓, 投資統計) with no dated releases and no stated periodicity; figures are served through linked query portals.

reports.title: Act for Industrial Innovation (產業創新條例) — including ‘Taiwan Chip Act’ provisions (Art. 10-2 etc.)
reports.publisher: Republic of China (Taiwan) / Ministry of Economic Affairs
reports.description: Core industrial-policy statute that provides the legal basis for R&D and advanced-process equipment tax incentives (the so-called Taiwan Chip Act provisions), smart-machinery and AI investment incentives, and related industrial-innovation measures. Continuously cited in semiconductor investment and tax-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Highest-value recurring-citation policy node for the semiconductor cluster. The Art. 10-2 incentives (high R&D intensity + advanced-equipment thresholds) are explicitly designed around the foundry and advanced-packaging model.
_referenced_by: Semiconductor and R&D investment decisions and announcements
MOEA industrial-policy and tax-incentive utilisation reports
reports._url_evidence: MOEA law system full text of 產業創新條例, including Article 10-2 investment tax-credit provisions for smart machinery, 5G, cybersecurity and AI.

reports.title: Semiconductor and electronic-components trade statistics (exports / imports by detailed HS)
reports.description: Detailed customs trade statistics for electronic components, integrated circuits, semiconductor devices and related products. Semiconductor-related items dominate Taiwan’s export structure and generate large trade surpluses.
reports._notes: Trade-side counterpart to the production series. Creates direct edges from the factory floor into the external-surplus and partner-concentration nodes.
_referenced_by: Headline trade statistics and BOP goods account

reports.title: Semiconductor / electronics employment and wage statistics
reports.publisher: DGBAS / Ministry of Labor / Science Park Administrations
reports.description: Employment counts and earnings levels in electronic components, computers/optical products and science-park IC firms. These segments sit well above average earnings and account for a disproportionate share of high-skill employment.
reports._notes: Labour-side of the dual structure. High electronics earnings versus the rest of the economy generate clear inequality and household-income edges.
_referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost (manufacturing)
reports._url_evidence: DGBAS 薪資及生產力統計 section (earnings and productivity statistics), the official series carrying employment and earnings by manufacturing industry.
reports._cadence_evidence: stat.gov.tw n=2712 is the 薪資及生產力統計 area; DGBAS SDDS metadata for Labor market: Wages/Earnings gives Periodicity 'Monthly' (40 days after reference month), and employment from the Manpower Survey is likewise 'Monthly' (35 days).

reports.title: United States–Taiwan Initiative on 21st-Century Trade (first agreement)
reports.description: First agreement under the Initiative (signed 2023, entered into force December 2024) covering anti-corruption, good regulatory practices, customs and trade facilitation, services domestic regulation, and SMEs. Foundation layer on which the later Agreement on Reciprocal Trade builds.
reports._notes: Foundational US–Taiwan trade instrument of the 2020s. Provides the regulatory and facilitation base that the deeper ART then expands into market access and economic-security commitments.
_referenced_by: Customs and trade-facilitation statistics and reform documents
TIFA Council and subsequent negotiation records

reports.title: AIT–TECRO Memorandum of Understanding on industrial parks, semiconductor investment and supply-chain cooperation (Jan 2026)
reports.description: MOU under which Taiwan commits to facilitate large-scale investment by Taiwanese firms into US semiconductor, AI, energy and related industrial parks/clusters, with financial support from the Taiwan side; US side provides preferential treatment considerations in Section 232 and related investigations. Explicitly links semiconductor capacity expansion in the United States to the bilateral economic-security partnership.
reports._notes: Direct bridge between the semiconductor manufacturing cluster and the sovereignty-protecting economic architecture. Large announced investment figures (hundreds of billions) make this a high-mass edge into both the chip and the US–Taiwan nodes.
_referenced_by: US–Taiwan Agreement on Reciprocal Trade fact sheets
Science-park and advanced-capacity statistics (outbound investment side)
reports._url_evidence: USTR fact sheet describing the AIT–TECRO MOU signed 15 January 2026 on industrial parks/clusters, Taiwanese semiconductor, EMS and energy investment in the US, and Section 232 preferential treatment.

reports.title: AI-related demand impact on Taiwan semiconductor production and export statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / DGBAS / industry sources cited officially
reports.description: Statistical and official commentary linking the surge in AI server, high-performance computing and advanced-packaging demand to the record growth rates in electronic-components and computers/optical production indices, science-park IC revenue, and related export orders.
reports._cadence_original: continuous (via monthly industrial and trade releases)
reports._notes: Demand-side narrative node that explains the extreme recent growth rates. Essential for understanding why the semiconductor cluster currently carries such high centrality and authority in the graph.
_referenced_by: Electronic Components and Computers/Optical production series
Export orders and semiconductor trade statistics
reports._cadence_evidence: The underlying MOEA releases are monthly on a fixed calendar: '25日 工業生產, 20日 外銷訂單', with dated releases 2026-07-23 (工業生產) and 2026-07-21 (外銷訂單).

reports.title: Export-control and technology-security alignment with the United States
reports.description: Policy and statistical traces of Taiwan’s alignment with US-led export-control regimes on advanced semiconductors and related technologies. Appears in ART security architecture language and in domestic implementation measures.
reports._notes: Security-layer node that links the commercial semiconductor cluster to the sovereignty-protecting economic architecture.
_referenced_by: US–Taiwan Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (security provisions)
reports._url_evidence: International Trade Administration 高科技貨品管理 section covering strategic high-tech (dual-use) commodity export controls and related announcements.
reports._cadence_evidence: ITA 戰略性高科技貨品 page (trade.gov.tw nodeID=4353) carries regulatory announcements filtered by date range with a 歷史區 archive; it states no publication frequency and the postings are issued as regulatory needs arise.

reports.title: National Defense Budget (Ministry of National Defense)
reports.description: Annual and special defence budget figures, including the headline MND allocation and the broader NATO-standard measure that incorporates veterans’ payments and coast-guard expenditure. Recent budgets have been set with a target of at least 3 % of GDP; the 2026 figure reaches approximately 3.32 % under the broader measure, with large year-on-year increases and dedicated special budgets for air and sea combat capability and asymmetric forces.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-security node. Rising share of GDP and the creation of multi-year special budgets for sea/air and asymmetric capabilities create direct edges into the broader public-finance and economic-resilience clusters.
_referenced_by: Fiscal and national-accounts analysis of government expenditure
reports._cadence_evidence: MND 預算及決算書 section is organised one budget book per fiscal year (110至114年國防部所屬預算書表), matching the annual 中央政府總預算 cycle (DGBAS publishes 115年度中央政府總預算案編列情形 once per year).

reports.title: National Defense Report (國防報告書)
reports.description: Periodic official report (most recently the 2025 edition) that sets out the threat assessment, force-structure priorities, readiness posture and policy direction of the ROC Armed Forces. Continuously cited in subsequent budget, procurement and strategic documents.
reports._notes: Highest-level recurring-citation defence policy node. Functions as the strategic counterpart to the purely statistical budget series.
_referenced_by: Defence budget justifications and special-budget statutes
reports._cadence_evidence: MND 歷年國防報告書專區 shows editions two years apart in the recent series — 110年 (2021), 112年 (2023), 114年 (2025) — i.e. one report every two years.

reports.title: Indigenous naval shipbuilding statistics and programmes (Tuo Chiang-class corvettes, Indigenous Defense Submarine, light frigates)
reports.description: Official and programme-level statistics and progress reporting on domestically built naval vessels — Tuo Chiang-class catamaran corvettes (multiple hulls commissioned or under construction), the Indigenous Defense Submarine (IDS / Hai Kun class) sea trials and follow-on plans, and the next-generation light-frigate programme. These programmes are central to asymmetric and sea-denial capability.
reports._cadence_original: continuous programme updates + periodic budget lines
reports._notes: Core navy and defence-industrial node. Domestic construction of corvettes and submarines creates edges into the broader industrial base and into the asymmetric-warfare priority that now dominates procurement rhetoric.
_referenced_by: Defence budget (military investment and special-budget lines)
Domestic industrial and employment statistics linked to shipyards
reports._cadence_evidence: No MND page states a release schedule for shipbuilding-programme statistics; programme information appears in ad hoc press items and in the biennial 國防報告書 / annual budget books rather than a dedicated series.

reports.title: US Foreign Military Sales / arms-sale notifications and backlog to Taiwan
reports.publisher: US Department of State / Defense Security Cooperation Agency / Congressional notifications (tracked in Taiwan and US official and analytical series)
reports.description: Statistical tracking of notified and backlog US arms sales to Taiwan (recent packages measured in tens of billions of dollars, with a rising share of asymmetric capabilities). Forms the quantitative backbone of the security dimension of the unofficial relationship.
reports._notes: High-authority external security node. Directly links the military cluster to the US–Taiwan economic-security architecture already captured in Batch 8.
_referenced_by: National Defense Report and procurement planning
reports._url_evidence: DSCA official Major Arms Sales congressional-notification series (now an archive; the page states new notifications moved to the State Department under EO 14383). Taiwan cases were not visible on the first page of results.
reports._cadence_evidence: DSCA Major Arms Sales is a rolling feed of congressional notifications posted as cases are approved (10 notices spanning 20 Jan–6 Feb 2026 on page 1, 15+ pages of archive plus a searchable Major Arms Sales Library); the page states no publication schedule.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Domestic defence-industry and military-investment statistics
reports.description: Statistics and programme reporting on domestic defence production, military investment expenditure, and the industrial base that supports indigenous shipbuilding, missiles, and other systems. Interacts with the broader manufacturing and high-tech industrial statistics.
reports._notes: Industrial edge of the military cluster. Creates potential links into the semiconductor and advanced-manufacturing nodes where dual-use technologies overlap.
_referenced_by: Industrial production and employment in related sectors
reports._cadence_evidence: MND's 業務統計及研究報告 section could not be read (robots-blocked) and no defence-industry statistical series with a stated frequency or countable editions was found on mnd.gov.tw.

reports.title: Special budgets for asymmetric force and defence resilience
reports.publisher: Ministry of National Defense / Executive Yuan / Legislative Yuan
reports.description: Multi-year special budget instruments dedicated to asymmetric capabilities, munitions stockpiles, C4ISR resilience, and whole-of-society defence resilience. Distinct from the regular annual defence budget and explicitly framed as responses to the current threat environment.
reports._notes: Policy and fiscal node that operationalises the shift toward asymmetric and resilient force design. High citation value in contemporary strategic analysis.
_referenced_by: Economic and social resilience special statutes
reports._url_evidence: DGBAS 特別預算 page under 政府預算 — the official central-government special-budget listing; individual plan rows load dynamically and were not rendered.
reports._cadence_evidence: The DGBAS 特別預算 page is organised by 計畫名稱 and 年度 — individually named special budgets each enacted under their own special statute (e.g. procurement special budgets), not a periodical; no recurring release cycle is stated.

reports.title: Military personnel and manpower statistics
